chapter_theme: The three classes of souls (மூவகைச் சீவ வர்க்கம்): souls are ranked by the impurities that bind them, the Vijnanakalas by anava alone, the Pralayakalas by anava and karma, the Sakalas by all three; Shakti and Siva yoke souls to maya in their play so as to lead them to Sivahood, and those who destroy the malas become Siva.
structure_note: 492 states the purpose of embodiment; 493 to 496 and 498 set out the classes and their subdivisions, with counts that do not agree (ten in 493, nine in 498); 497, 499 and 500 turn to those who pass beyond the malas.

492.reading: Shakti and Siva in their play make souls, yoke them within the joining of the two mayas, have them enter the pure turiya, enter their minds and make them full of Siva.
492.nuance: இருமாயை is traditionally pure and impure maya. விளையாட்டு (play) names creation as the Lord's sport, and the end of the process is that the soul becomes சிவமயம், filled with Siva.

493.reading: The Vijnanars are four, those in Pralayakala who 'know their own' three, and the unknowing in Sakala three; ten in all, these are the divisions of the Vijnanars and the rest.
493.nuance: விஞ்ஞானர், தஞ்ஞானர், அஞ்ஞானர் are technical names; how the 4, 3 and 3 subdivisions are made is not stated, and 498 counts nine.

494.reading: The Vijnanars are those who have left the kevala state; the thanjnanars who draw near are the eight Vidyesvaras; the enjnanars are the seven crore Lords of mantra; the true knowers stand having left anava.
494.nuance: The eight Vidyesvaras and the seventy million Mantresvaras are classes of liberated or near-liberated souls in Siddhanta. The play on -ஞானர் through all four lines makes the classes hard to separate.

495.reading: In the second class all attain release; within the second are the bound with two malas, said to be the hundred and eight Rudras; the Sakalas, beset with conflict, have three malas.
495.nuance: இரண்டாவது, the second, is taken as the Pralayakalas, bound by anava and karma. The 108 Rudras as a class of these souls is the tradition's reading.

496.reading: Between the bound soul and the freed soul stand those who have become intermediate; those unable to wither the three malas, sunk in sound, are in the Sakala state.
496.nuance: Line 1 (பெத்தெத்த சித்தொடு பேண்முத்தச் சித்தது) and சத்தத்து அமிழ்ந்து are obscure; the verse may be corrupt.

497.reading: Those who have become Siva and destroyed the five firm malas will not come to nothing; these siddhas live in the three ends, end their becoming, are free of soul-bondage and bond, and have sought and seen the ninefold tattva.
497.nuance: The five malas are traditionally anava, karma, maya, mayeya and tirodhana. முத்தாந்தம் is taken as Vedanta, Siddhanta and Nadanta. நவமான may be 'ninefold' or 'new'; the variant நாடிக்கொண்டாரே changes little.

498.reading: The Vijnanars dwell in anava's kevala state; the (second) Vijnanars stay in maya with two malas; the unknowing are the Sakalas of Sakala; the Vijnanars and the rest are nine different kinds of soul.
498.nuance: The second line repeats விஞ்ஞானர் where the scheme needs the Pralayakalas; this may be a slip in the text. The count of nine differs from 493's ten.

499.reading: By karma, the Vijnanars joined to a body enter wombs of four walls, touch some knowledge and a body, pass on through what lies between, become true knowers and attain Siva: this is the truth.
499.nuance: Lines 2 and 3 (அனையான கன்மத்தி நால்சுவர் யோனி, எஞ்ஞான மெய்தீண்டி) are obscure and may be corrupt; the sense of a path from embodiment to Siva is clear only in outline.

500.reading: Those reached by anava and avidya, without waking; bindu, nada, Sakala and the rest; those who have reached anava and the others are not they; the Shakti and Siva tattvas rise far above.
500.nuance: The syntax is broken and the verse may be corrupt; it seems to set the pure tattvas of Shakti and Siva above the states bound by anava.

links.note: 115 states that when Pati draws near, Pasu and Pasam do not remain; 497 describes those in whom this has happened: become Siva, free of பசுபாசம், the malas destroyed.
Both make embodiment serve release: in 474 the body is fashioned so that the bond may leave the soul, in 492 Shakti and Siva yoke souls to maya so as to make them full of Siva.

source_issues: 493 counts ten kinds of soul and 498 nine.
498 line 2 repeats விஞ்ஞானர் where the Pralayakalas are expected.
500 line 4 ends with a stray வரன்றே, apparently repeated from line 3 (ரவரன்றே); the verse's syntax is broken.
496 line 1 and 499 lines 2 and 3 are obscure and may be corrupt.
